Planned DER curtailment is not withdrawn to rescue unmet requests
All six action variables have verified nonzero effects in legal states
Overdue overload retains a nonempty action domain and explicit violation
Both curtailment and deferral protect rigid native load
Offsetting curtailment and repayment create no net payment or DR value
Withholding non-due repayment does not create credited DR
Paid labels alone add expenditure without changing response or value
Necessary-first DER rescue is global within announced resources
Complete six-action worked example and fixed-response alternative
With fixed sufficient supply, follower readaptation yields zero or positive economic procurement
Unresolved U03: supply restriction induces unpaid proactive curtailment despite default compensation
Unresolved U01: compensation does not dominate arbitrarily high purchase cost
Unresolved U02: fully served DER-to-UC substitution can profit despite curtailment cost
Only actual repayment removes oldest energy; overdue remains
Equal bids are pro-rata and invariant to consumer order
Retained DER bid affects scarce allocation and actual bill
Invalid joint actions are rejected rather than overwritten
